cfg_edges.rationale: Every received message is validated and routed.
Image messages take the OCR pipeline path.
Tag commands take the search path.
The tag-list command takes the tag-list path.
The archived image is passed to AI OCR.
The AI output is parsed and validated.

cfg_edges.condition: OCR succeeded: parsed output contains readable memo data
OCR failed: text could not be read
cfg_edges.rationale: Declared failure handling sends retake guidance.
The completion message is sent after the record is stored.
The memo database is read for the tag search.
Stored memos are filtered by the extracted tag.
The search results are sent to the user.
Stored memos are aggregated into the tag list.
The tag list is sent to the user.

dfg_edges.rationale: Routing consumes the received message event.
The image path consumes the routed image message.
AI OCR reads the memo image.
Parsing consumes the raw AI output.
The validated record fields are stored.
The stored record includes the Link to the original image from the archive.
The completion message quotes the title, tags and summary.
The completion message is delivered to the sending user.
The failure signal triggers the retake guidance.
The guidance is delivered to the sending user.
Tag extraction consumes the routed tag command.
Filtering matches memos against the extracted tag.
Filtering searches the stored memo rows.
The result message is delivered to the user.
The results are delivered to the sending user.
Tag aggregation consumes the stored memo rows.
The tag list is delivered to the user.
The tag list is delivered to the sending user.

notes: Three declared branches (image OCR pipeline, tag search, tag list) plus the declared OCR-failure handling. Native-only behaviors excluded as undeclared: the 'Processing... please wait' interim reply, the usage-guidance reply for messages that are neither image nor command, and the credential configuration node. Image retrieval from the LINE content API is folded into the declared Drive-save action because the frozen requirement declares only 'save the image to Google Drive'. Reading the memo database is modelled once per command branch because each branch performs its own read in its own execution path.
